title: 只动 Harness，就能把 GLM-5.3-Flash 推到 Opus-5 身侧！ / GLM-5.3-Flash × J-Space Capability Realization Report
description: A/B evaluation report of J-Space V3.7 (inference-time cognitive control suite) on GLM-5.3-Flash, covering Terminal-Bench 2.1, DeepSWE, ALE, AutomationBench and HLE subsets, GAIA-based efficiency measurements, and reproduction across five model families. Supersedes the retired DeepSeek V4 report archived under 10.5281/zenodo.21971185.
